name: @erichare/astra-mcp

tools.name: connection_status
tools.description: Check whether Astra DB credentials are configured and working: where the token, endpoint, and keyspace come from (env, .env, plugin settings, Astra CLI), which database is targeted, and a live connectivity check. Call it first when another tool reports not_configured or an auth error.

check.description: Make a live request to verify the connection (default true).

tools.name: list_databases
tools.description: List the Astra databases this token can access (DevOps API): name, id, status, regions with Data API endpoints, and keyspaces. Use it to choose the `database` argument of other tools.

tools.name: database_overview
tools.description: Map a database: keyspaces → collections (vector dimension/metric, vectorize model, lexical/rerank, estimated counts) and tables (column and vector-column counts). Start here to see what exists. Renders an interactive overview.

database.description: Database to use: name, id, or Data API endpoint URL. Omit for the configured default.

includeCounts.description: Estimated document counts per collection (one request each).

emit.description: html_file also writes a self-contained HTML page and returns a link to it — only for terminal-only hosts, when the user asks for a visual.

tools.name: describe_collection
tools.description: Show one collection's configuration and shape: vector settings, vectorize and rerank services, lexical, indexing allow/deny, default id type, estimated count, and a sample document with field types. Use before writing queries or code against it.

database.description: Database to use: name, id, or Data API endpoint URL. Omit for the configured default.

keyspace.description: Keyspace. Omit for the configured/default keyspace.

emit.description: html_file also writes a self-contained HTML page and returns a link to it — only for terminal-only hosts, when the user asks for a visual.

tools.name: describe_table
tools.description: Show one table's schema: columns and types, primary key (partition and clustering columns), indexes, vector columns, and sample rows. Use before writing queries or code against it.

database.description: Database to use: name, id, or Data API endpoint URL. Omit for the configured default.

keyspace.description: Keyspace. Omit for the configured/default keyspace.

includeSample.description: Include up to 3 sample rows (vectors omitted).

emit.description: html_file also writes a self-contained HTML page and returns a link to it — only for terminal-only hosts, when the user asks for a visual.

tools.name: find
tools.description: Read documents (collections) or rows (tables) with an optional Data API filter, sort, and projection. Returns pages of 20 plus nextPageState for more. For similarity search use vector_search. Renders an interactive explorer.

database.description: Database to use: name, id, or Data API endpoint URL. Omit for the configured default.

keyspace.description: Keyspace. Omit for the configured/default keyspace.

kind.description: Only needed when a collection and a table share the name; otherwise detected.

filter.description: Data API filter, e.g. {"status": "active", "year": {"$gte": 2020}}. Typed ids as {"$uuid": "…"} / {"$objectId": "…"}.

sort.description: Non-vector sort, e.g. {"createdAt": -1}. For similarity use vector_search.

projection.description: Fields to include (1) or exclude (0), e.g. {"title": 1, "author": 1}.

limit.description: Documents to return (rounded up to whole pages of 20).

pageState.description: nextPageState from a previous call, to continue paging.

emit.description: html_file also writes a self-contained HTML page and returns a link to it — only for terminal-only hosts, when the user asks for a visual.

tools.name: vector_search
tools.description: Similarity search by natural-language `query` (server-side vectorize), an explicit `vector`, or `documentId` (more like this). `hybrid` combines vector and lexical (BM25) results with reranking on collections that have both. A filter narrows candidates. Returns ranked hits with similarity scores; renders an interactive results view.

database.description: Database to use: name, id, or Data API endpoint URL. Omit for the configured default.

keyspace.description: Keyspace. Omit for the configured/default keyspace.

kind.description: Only needed when a collection and a table share the name; otherwise detected.

vector.description: A query embedding (must match the dimension).

documentId.description: Find items similar to this existing document (collections).

idType.description: How to interpret documentId (auto follows the collection's defaultId).

vectorColumn.description: Tables only: which vector column to search (default: the only one).

hybrid.description: Collections with lexical + rerank: combined vector + BM25 search, reranked.

filter.description: Data API filter, e.g. {"status": "active", "year": {"$gte": 2020}}. Typed ids as {"$uuid": "…"} / {"$objectId": "…"}.

projection.description: Fields to include (1) or exclude (0), e.g. {"title": 1, "author": 1}.

emit.description: html_file also writes a self-contained HTML page and returns a link to it — only for terminal-only hosts, when the user asks for a visual.

tools.name: count
tools.description: Exact count of documents in a collection matching a filter, up to upperBound (Data API maximum 1000); unfiltered counts also report the estimated total.

database.description: Database to use: name, id, or Data API endpoint URL. Omit for the configured default.

keyspace.description: Keyspace. Omit for the configured/default keyspace.

filter.description: Data API filter, e.g. {"status": "active", "year": {"$gte": 2020}}. Typed ids as {"$uuid": "…"} / {"$objectId": "…"}.

upperBound.description: Stop counting at this many (Data API maximum 1000).

tools.name: distinct_values
tools.description: Distinct values of a field (dot paths allowed) across up to scanLimit documents or rows, optionally filtered — useful for discovering categories before filtering.

database.description: Database to use: name, id, or Data API endpoint URL. Omit for the configured default.

keyspace.description: Keyspace. Omit for the configured/default keyspace.

kind.description: Only needed when a collection and a table share the name; otherwise detected.

filter.description: Data API filter, e.g. {"status": "active", "year": {"$gte": 2020}}. Typed ids as {"$uuid": "…"} / {"$objectId": "…"}.

tools.name: list_vectorize_providers
tools.description: List the embedding (vectorize) and reranking providers and models available to the database, with dimensions and authentication options. Use before create_collection with a vectorize service.

database.description: Database to use: name, id, or Data API endpoint URL. Omit for the configured default.

tools.name: code_examples
tools.description: Canonical Data API client code for Python (astrapy), TypeScript (@datastax/astra-db-ts), Java, C#, and Go from the bundled, documentation-derived example library. Use when writing application code; snippets read ASTRA_DB_APPLICATION_TOKEN / ASTRA_DB_API_ENDPOINT from the environment.

query.description: What the code should do, e.g. "create a vector collection with vectorize", "find with filter and sort".

mode.description: content: include source; list: file names only.

tools.name: insert
tools.description: Insert 1–1000 documents into a collection (or rows into a table), in chunks. On vectorize collections use "$vectorize": "text" to embed server-side; otherwise "$vector": [...] for your own embeddings. Reports inserted ids and any per-document errors.

database.description: Database to use: name, id, or Data API endpoint URL. Omit for the configured default.

keyspace.description: Keyspace. Omit for the configured/default keyspace.

kind.description: Only needed when a collection and a table share the name; otherwise detected.

documents.description: Documents (collections) or rows (tables). Use "$vectorize": "text" for server-side embeddings on vectorize collections.

ordered.description: Stop at the first error (default: insert what can be inserted).

tools.name: update
tools.description: Update the document/row matching a filter with operators ($set, $unset, $inc, $push, …). `many` updates every match (collections only); `many` or an empty filter requires the user's confirmation. `upsert` inserts when nothing matches.

database.description: Database to use: name, id, or Data API endpoint URL. Omit for the configured default.

keyspace.description: Keyspace. Omit for the configured/default keyspace.

kind.description: Only needed when a collection and a table share the name; otherwise detected.

filter.description: Data API filter, e.g. {"status": "active", "year": {"$gte": 2020}}. Typed ids as {"$uuid": "…"} / {"$objectId": "…"}.

many.description: Update every match (collections only). Requires confirmation.

confirm.description: Set ONLY after you described the impact and the user approved it in a later message: the exact target name. The original request is not approval; never guess or self-approve.

tools.name: delete
tools.description: Delete the document/row matching a filter. `many` deletes every match; `many` or an empty filter requires the user's confirmation.

database.description: Database to use: name, id, or Data API endpoint URL. Omit for the configured default.

keyspace.description: Keyspace. Omit for the configured/default keyspace.

kind.description: Only needed when a collection and a table share the name; otherwise detected.

filter.description: Data API filter, e.g. {"status": "active", "year": {"$gte": 2020}}. Typed ids as {"$uuid": "…"} / {"$objectId": "…"}.

confirm.description: Set ONLY after you described the impact and the user approved it in a later message: the exact target name. The original request is not approval; never guess or self-approve.

tools.name: create_collection
tools.description: Create a collection: plain JSON, vector (dimension + metric), or vectorize (server-side embeddings from a provider — see list_vectorize_providers), optionally with lexical (BM25) and rerank for hybrid search, indexing allow/deny, and a default id type. Idempotent when the settings match an existing collection.

database.description: Database to use: name, id, or Data API endpoint URL. Omit for the configured default.

keyspace.description: Keyspace. Omit for the configured/default keyspace.

dimension.description: Required unless a vectorize service sets it.

lexical.description: Enable BM25 lexical search (needed for hybrid).

indexing.description: Index only (allow) or all but (deny) these fields. Deny large text fields you never filter on.

tools.name: create_table
tools.description: Create a table with typed columns (text, int, uuid, timestamp, map/list/set, vector…) and a primary key (partition columns plus optional clustering order). Then add indexes with create_index for columns you filter or vector-search on.

database.description: Database to use: name, id, or Data API endpoint URL. Omit for the configured default.

keyspace.description: Keyspace. Omit for the configured/default keyspace.

tools.name: create_index
tools.description: Create an index on a table column: regular (filtering and sorting), vector (similarity search on a vector column), or text (BM25 lexical search). Collections index fields automatically.

database.description: Database to use: name, id, or Data API endpoint URL. Omit for the configured default.

keyspace.description: Keyspace. Omit for the configured/default keyspace.

table.description: Table name (collections index automatically; use indexing on create_collection).

options.description: e.g. {"metric": "dot_product"} for vector, {"caseSensitive": false} for regular.

tools.name: drop
tools.description: Permanently drop a collection, a table, or a table index, with all its data. Always requires the user's explicit confirmation.

database.description: Database to use: name, id, or Data API endpoint URL. Omit for the configured default.

keyspace.description: Keyspace. Omit for the configured/default keyspace.

name.description: Name of the collection, table, or table index.

confirm.description: Set ONLY after you described the impact and the user approved it in a later message: the exact target name. The original request is not approval; never guess or self-approve.

instructions:
Unofficial JEStats integration for Astra DB (DataStax / IBM): inspect, query, vector-search, and change data via the Data API.

Targeting: every data tool takes optional `database` (name, id, or endpoint URL) and `keyspace`; omit both for the configured default. Use list_databases when unsure which database the user means.

Start with database_overview or describe_collection / describe_table before writing code or queries against a collection — never guess field names, vector dimensions, or primary keys. find pages with nextPageState; vector_search takes `query` text (vectorize), a `vector`, or a `documentId`; `hybrid` needs lexical + rerank.

Writes: insert/update/delete/create_*/drop change real data. Drops, updates/deletes with `many` or an empty filter need the user's confirmation — the host may ask them directly; otherwise explain the impact, ask, and only after they approve pass `confirm` with the exact name. The original request is not approval; never self-confirm.

Credentials: if a tool returns not_configured, ask the user to run `npx -y @erichare/astra-mcp login` in their own terminal (no restart needed). Never ask them to paste a token into chat, and never write tokens into files other than a git-ignored .env. If one is pasted anyway, don't use it; suggest rotating it.

Writing application code: call code_examples for canonical client snippets (Python, TypeScript, Java, C#, Go); app code reads ASTRA_DB_APPLICATION_TOKEN and ASTRA_DB_API_ENDPOINT from the environment.

database_overview, describe_*, find, and vector_search render an interactive view in hosts that support MCP Apps; after they do, summarize briefly instead of repeating the data.
